as_told.title: Moon 'rang like a bell' after Apollo 12 booster impact

plain: During the Apollo missions, the US space agency NASA's flights to the Moon around 1969, astronauts left seismometers, instruments that measure tremors, on the surface, and when a used rocket stage hit the Moon it reportedly rang like a bell. Michels tells it himself on several episodes, naming Apollo 10 in one, Apollo 12 in another, and saying the booster was crashed on purpose and the Moon rang for three hours, leaving NASA very confused. The researcher Randall Carlson says NASA gathered three or four years of data showing the Moon has a long vibrational train. The philosopher Jason Jorjani says the test was then repeated on purpose, he thinks on Apollo 13. It comes up on an episode titled The Moon Is An Alien Spaceship, as a hint that the Moon may not be what it seems inside.
